name: Flakturm Single Blast Door Leaf (animatable, rebuilt)
description: T1 rebuild (2026-10-12): single riveted steel bunker door leaf by image-seeded Tripo regeneration. Straight hard-surface edges, isolated leaf without merged frame, 4-spoke lock wheel (protruding hub), observation slit, hinge knuckles on the -X (outer) edge. FILE units are 0.5x the placed size: measured 0.354 x 0.998 x 0.666 m (depth includes wheel-hub protrusion; slab itself ~0.15-0.2 m). Place at recommendedScale 2.0 -> ~0.708 x 1.996 m door leaf and squash depth via non-uniform Z scale (approx 0.25-0.5) so the slab sinks into the wall; front hardware faces the room. Mirror for the right leaf via scale.x = -1 (HingePivot socket mirrors with it -> hinges stay on the outer edges). Animate the leaf by rotating around the HingePivot socket (x = -0.177 file units, = -0.354 placed), i.e. rotation about the -X outer edge. Front-face hardware only; double-sided read for corridor-level use is an OPEN follow-up. Replaces the 9.6 MB v1 leaf (7593 tris, 2.2 MB GLB, Tier-3 <3 MB compliant).
author: Small World Machine Studio
